description: Apple cookies - RECIPE (small batch) Ingredients:  110g soften butter  2-3 tbs sugar 1 egg yolk Vanilla (I use vanilla sugar) 180g flour A pinch of baking powder A pinch of salt How to: - cream butter, sugar, egg yolk and vanilla together - add in flour, a pinch of baking powder and salt - separate the dough into 3 - add red and green food coloring into each of the 2 smaller doughs, and refrigerate  - to shape the dough, follow the steps in the video - refrigerate the dough before cutting it - cut the dough, place on a parchment paper and refrigerate again - preheat your oven at 170-180° and bake 10 to 15min (depending on on your oven) 🧚I “glue” the red and green doughs with a touch of water 🧚I use melted chocolate to draw the eyes   #baking101 #sugarcookies #cutebaking #whimsy #baketok
